## Permitted uses

| Property | Term |
|---|---|
| Source | SERVICE |
| USD-to-CNY conversion | Not permitted |
| Beneficiary segments | GENERAL |
| Charge per nonzero allocation | 200 USD cents |

A source payment may combine permitted lots from one account. Add the charges for each nonzero source allocation. Current holds and available principal are checked at execution. See `KB-source_routes-scope` and `KB-source_routes-effects`.
title: SERVICE source permissions and charge
